<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="16"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="toKkPfX3L0HHUZ29oHea"> <mxGraphModel dx="3333" dy="1848" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam nodesep 70
skinparam ranksep 90
skinparam Padding 6

' Deixa as linhas e bordas mais escuras e nítidas no draw.io
skinparam ArrowColor #222222
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.6
skinparam ArrowFontColor #111111
skinparam ArrowFontSize 12
skinparam ClassBorderColor #222222
skinparam ClassBorderThickness 1.5

' Destaque visual para Hot Spots e Instâncias do Framework
skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor<<hot spot>> #FFF3CD
 BorderColor<<hot spot>> #D39E00
 BackgroundColor<<template method>> #E2F0D9
 BorderColor<<template method>> #548235
 BackgroundColor<<instance>> #E8F4FD
 BorderColor<<instance>> #2E75B6
}

package \"sales.application (Frozen Spot)\" {

 class CheckoutService {
 - addressRepository : SaleAddressRepository
 - shoppingCartRepository : SaleShoppingCartRepository
 - saleService : SaleService
 + execute(input : CheckoutInput) : SaleOutput
 + simulateFreight(addressId : UUID, userId : UUID) : BigDecimal
 }

 class SaleService <<template method>> {
 - saleRepository : SaleRepository
 - productRepository : ProductRepository
 - stockRepository : StockRepository
 - storeAvailability : StoreAvailability
 - recipeConsumptionService : RecipeConsumptionService
 - orderPricingStrategy : OrderPricingStrategy
 + createSale(input : CreateSaleInput) : SaleOutput
 + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
 + listSales(status : SaleStatus, date : LocalDateTime) : List<SaleOutput>
 + getSaleById(saleId : String) : SaleOutput
 + ListSalesByUser(userId : String) : List<SaleOutput>
 }

 class SaleStatusService <<template method>> {
 - saleRepository : SaleRepository
 - stockRepository : StockRepository
 - recipeConsumptionService : RecipeConsumptionService
 - lotAllocationStrategy : LotAllocationStrategy
 + confirmSale(saleId : String) : SaleOutput
 + dispatchDelivery(saleId : String) : SaleOutput
 + confirmDelivery(saleId : String, userId : UUID) : SaleOutput
 + cancelSale(saleId : String) : void
 }

 class RecipeConsumptionService {
 - productRepository : ProductRepository
 - lotAllocationStrategy : LotAllocationStrategy
 + accumulateConsumption(totalConsumption : Map<Long, Integer>, productId : Long, quantity : int) : void
 }

 ' Ordem horizontal fixa (1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4) sem cruzamento de diagonais
 CheckoutService -right-> SaleService : delega criação >
 SaleService -[hidden]right-> SaleStatusService
 SaleStatusService -right-> RecipeConsumptionService : calcula insumos/estorno >
}

package \"sales.domain (Core & Hot Spot 2)\" {

 package \"repositories & ports\" {
 interface SaleShoppingCartRepository {
 + getItems(shoppingCartId : String) : List<SaleItemInput>
 + clearItems(shoppingCartId : String) : void
 }

 interface SaleAddressRepository {
 + getAddress(addressId : UUID, userId : UUID) : Address
 }

 interface StoreAvailability {
 + isAvailableForOrders() : boolean
 }

 interface SaleRepository {
 + save(sale : Sale) : Sale
 + findById(id : SaleId) : Optional<Sale>
 + findAll(status : SaleStatus, date : LocalDateTime) : List<Sale>
 + findByUserId(id : UserId) : List<Sale>
 }

 interface StockRepository {
 + getCurrentBalance(stockItemId : Long) : int
 + deductStock(stockItemId : Long, quantity : int, reason : String) : void
 + addStock(stockItemId : Long, quantity : int, reason : String) : void
 }

 interface ProductRepository {
 + getCurrentPrice(productId : Long) : BigDecimal
 + getRecipe(productId : Long) : List<RecipeItem>
 }

 ' Força a ordem exata das colunas (1 a 6) alinhadas aos Services acima
 SaleShoppingCartRepository -[hidden]right-> SaleAddressRepository
 SaleAddressRepository -[hidden]right-> StoreAvailability
 StoreAvailability -[hidden]right-> SaleRepository
 SaleRepository -[hidden]right-> StockRepository
 StockRepository -[hidden]right-> ProductRepository
 }

 package \"model & hot spot\" {
 class Address {
 - addressId : UUID
 - name : String
 - street : String
 - number : String
 - neighborhood : String
 - city : String
 - state : String
 - zipCode : String
 }

 interface OrderPricingStrategy <<hot spot>> {
 + calculateOrderTotal(sale : Sale, items : List<SaleItem>, baseDeliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
 + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
 }

 class Sale {
 - id : SaleId
 - date : LocalDateTime
 - status : SaleStatus
 - items : List<SaleItem>
 - observation : String
 - userId : UserId
 - deliveryFee : BigDecimal
 - deliveryStreet : String
 - deliveryNumber : String
 - deliveryCity : String
 - deliveryNeighborhood : String
 - deliveryZipCode : String
 + addItem(productId : Long, quantity : int, unitPrice : BigDecimal) : void
 + calculateTotal(deliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
 + confirm() : void
 + dispatch() : void
 + deliver() : void
 + cancel() : void
 }

 class SaleItem {
 - id : SaleItemId
 - productId : Long
 - quantity : int
 - unitPrice : BigDecimal
 + getSubtotal() : BigDecimal
 }

 enum SaleStatus {
 PENDENTE
 EM_PREPARO
 EM_ROTA
 ENTREGUE
 CANCELADA
 }

 class RecipeItem <<record>> {
 + stockItemId : Long
 + quantityPerUnit : int
 }

 ' Relacionamentos horizontais alinhados às colunas (zero cruzamento)
 Address <-right- OrderPricingStrategy : calcula frete
 OrderPricingStrategy -right-> Sale : precifica >
 Sale \"1\" -right-> \"1..*\" SaleItem : contém >
 Sale -down-> SaleStatus : possui status >
 SaleItem -[hidden]right-> RecipeItem
 }
}

package \"instances.sales (Especializações do Hot Spot 2)\" {

 class BurgerPricingStrategy <<instance>> {
 + calculateOrderTotal(sale : Sale, items : List<SaleItem>, baseDeliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
 + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
 --
 Regra: Cardápio fixo + Tabela de entrega por bairros locais
 }

 class PharmaPricingStrategy <<instance>> {
 + calculateOrderTotal(sale : Sale, items : List<SaleItem>, baseDeliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
 + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
 --
 Regra: Princípios ativos + Taxa de manipulação/cápsulas + Frete térmico
 }

 class PcBuilderPricingStrategy <<instance>> {
 + calculateOrderTotal(sale : Sale, items : List<SaleItem>, baseDeliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
 + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
 --
 Regra: Peças + Mão de obra/Stress Test + Seguro ad valorem (1,5%)
 }

 BurgerPricingStrategy .up.|> OrderPricingStrategy
 PharmaPricingStrategy .up.|> OrderPricingStrategy
 PcBuilderPricingStrategy .up.|> OrderPricingStrategy

 BurgerPricingStrategy -[hidden]right-> PharmaPricingStrategy
 PharmaPricingStrategy -[hidden]right-> PcBuilderPricingStrategy
}

' Relacionamentos monotônicos (Col 1..2 | Col 3..4 | Col 4..5 | Col 6) -> ZERO cruzamentos!
CheckoutService -down-> SaleShoppingCartRepository
CheckoutService -down-> SaleAddressRepository

SaleService -down-> StoreAvailability
SaleService -down-> SaleRepository

SaleStatusService -down-> SaleRepository
SaleStatusService -down-> StockRepository

RecipeConsumptionService -down-> ProductRepository

' Alinhamento vertical coluna a coluna entre Repositórios e Modelo
SaleAddressRepository -down-> Address : consulta >
StoreAvailability -[hidden]down-> OrderPricingStrategy
SaleRepository -down-> Sale : persiste >
StockRepository -[hidden]down-> SaleItem
ProductRepository -down-> RecipeItem : consulta ficha técnica >

g.data-meta-plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam nodesep 70
skinparam ranksep 90
skinparam Padding 6

' Deixa as linhas e bordas mais escuras e nítidas no draw.io
skinparam ArrowColor #222222
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.6
skinparam ArrowFontColor #111111
skinparam ArrowFontSize 12
skinparam ClassBorderColor #222222
skinparam ClassBorderThickness 1.5

' Destaque visual para Hot Spots e Instâncias do Framework
skinparam class {
    BackgroundColor<<hot spot>> #FFF3CD
    BorderColor<<hot spot>> #D39E00
    BackgroundColor<<template method>> #E2F0D9
    BorderColor<<template method>> #548235
    BackgroundColor<<instance>> #E8F4FD
    BorderColor<<instance>> #2E75B6
}

package "sales.application (Frozen Spot)" {

    class CheckoutService {
        - addressRepository : SaleAddressRepository
        - shoppingCartRepository : SaleShoppingCartRepository
        - saleService : SaleService
        + execute(input : CheckoutInput) : SaleOutput
        + simulateFreight(addressId : UUID, userId : UUID) : BigDecimal
    }

    class SaleService <<template method>> {
        - saleRepository : SaleRepository
        - productRepository : ProductRepository
        - stockRepository : StockRepository
        - storeAvailability : StoreAvailability
        - recipeConsumptionService : RecipeConsumptionService
        - orderPricingStrategy : OrderPricingStrategy
        + createSale(input : CreateSaleInput) : SaleOutput
        + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
        + listSales(status : SaleStatus, date : LocalDateTime) : List<SaleOutput>
        + getSaleById(saleId : String) : SaleOutput
        + ListSalesByUser(userId : String) : List<SaleOutput>
    }

    class SaleStatusService <<template method>> {
        - saleRepository : SaleRepository
        - stockRepository : StockRepository
        - recipeConsumptionService : RecipeConsumptionService
        - lotAllocationStrategy : LotAllocationStrategy
        + confirmSale(saleId : String) : SaleOutput
        + dispatchDelivery(saleId : String) : SaleOutput
        + confirmDelivery(saleId : String, userId : UUID) : SaleOutput
        + cancelSale(saleId : String) : void
    }

    class RecipeConsumptionService {
        - productRepository : ProductRepository
        - lotAllocationStrategy : LotAllocationStrategy
        + accumulateConsumption(totalConsumption : Map<Long, Integer>, productId : Long, quantity : int) : void
    }

    ' Ordem horizontal fixa (1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4) sem cruzamento de diagonais
    CheckoutService -right-> SaleService : delega criação >
    SaleService -[hidden]right-> SaleStatusService
    SaleStatusService -right-> RecipeConsumptionService : calcula insumos/estorno >
}

package "sales.domain (Core & Hot Spot 2)" {

    package "repositories & ports" {
        interface SaleShoppingCartRepository {
            + getItems(shoppingCartId : String) : List<SaleItemInput>
            + clearItems(shoppingCartId : String) : void
        }

        interface SaleAddressRepository {
            + getAddress(addressId : UUID, userId : UUID) : Address
        }

        interface StoreAvailability {
            + isAvailableForOrders() : boolean
        }

        interface SaleRepository {
            + save(sale : Sale) : Sale
            + findById(id : SaleId) : Optional<Sale>
            + findAll(status : SaleStatus, date : LocalDateTime) : List<Sale>
            + findByUserId(id : UserId) : List<Sale>
        }

        interface StockRepository {
            + getCurrentBalance(stockItemId : Long) : int
            + deductStock(stockItemId : Long, quantity : int, reason : String) : void
            + addStock(stockItemId : Long, quantity : int, reason : String) : void
        }

        interface ProductRepository {
            + getCurrentPrice(productId : Long) : BigDecimal
            + getRecipe(productId : Long) : List<RecipeItem>
        }

        ' Força a ordem exata das colunas (1 a 6) alinhadas aos Services acima
        SaleShoppingCartRepository -[hidden]right-> SaleAddressRepository
        SaleAddressRepository -[hidden]right-> StoreAvailability
        StoreAvailability -[hidden]right-> SaleRepository
        SaleRepository -[hidden]right-> StockRepository
        StockRepository -[hidden]right-> ProductRepository
    }

    package "model & hot spot" {
        class Address {
            - addressId : UUID
            - name : String
            - street : String
            - number : String
            - neighborhood : String
            - city : String
            - state : String
            - zipCode : String
        }

        interface OrderPricingStrategy <<hot spot>> {
            + calculateOrderTotal(sale : Sale, items : List<SaleItem>, baseDeliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
            + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
        }

        class Sale {
            - id : SaleId
            - date : LocalDateTime
            - status : SaleStatus
            - items : List<SaleItem>
            - observation : String
            - userId : UserId
            - deliveryFee : BigDecimal
            - deliveryStreet : String
            - deliveryNumber : String
            - deliveryCity : String
            - deliveryNeighborhood : String
            - deliveryZipCode : String
            + addItem(productId : Long, quantity : int, unitPrice : BigDecimal) : void
            + calculateTotal(deliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
            + confirm() : void
            + dispatch() : void
            + deliver() : void
            + cancel() : void
        }

        class SaleItem {
            - id : SaleItemId
            - productId : Long
            - quantity : int
            - unitPrice : BigDecimal
            + getSubtotal() : BigDecimal
        }

        enum SaleStatus {
            PENDENTE
            EM_PREPARO
            EM_ROTA
            ENTREGUE
            CANCELADA
        }

        class RecipeItem <<record>> {
            + stockItemId : Long
            + quantityPerUnit : int
        }

        ' Relacionamentos horizontais alinhados às colunas (zero cruzamento)
        Address <-right- OrderPricingStrategy : calcula frete
        OrderPricingStrategy -right-> Sale : precifica >
        Sale "1" -right-> "1..*" SaleItem : contém >
        Sale -down-> SaleStatus : possui status >
        SaleItem -[hidden]right-> RecipeItem
    }
}

package "instances.sales (Especializações do Hot Spot 2)" {

    class BurgerPricingStrategy <<instance>> {
        + calculateOrderTotal(sale : Sale, items : List<SaleItem>, baseDeliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
        + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
        --
        Regra: Cardápio fixo + Tabela de entrega por bairros locais
    }

    class PharmaPricingStrategy <<instance>> {
        + calculateOrderTotal(sale : Sale, items : List<SaleItem>, baseDeliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
        + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
        --
        Regra: Princípios ativos + Taxa de manipulação/cápsulas + Frete térmico
    }

    class PcBuilderPricingStrategy <<instance>> {
        + calculateOrderTotal(sale : Sale, items : List<SaleItem>, baseDeliveryFee : BigDecimal) : BigDecimal
        + calculateDeliveryFee(address : Address) : BigDecimal
        --
        Regra: Peças + Mão de obra/Stress Test + Seguro ad valorem (1,5%)
    }

    BurgerPricingStrategy .up.|> OrderPricingStrategy
    PharmaPricingStrategy .up.|> OrderPricingStrategy
    PcBuilderPricingStrategy .up.|> OrderPricingStrategy

    BurgerPricingStrategy -[hidden]right-> PharmaPricingStrategy
    PharmaPricingStrategy -[hidden]right-> PcBuilderPricingStrategy
}

' Relacionamentos monotônicos (Col 1..2 | Col 3..4 | Col 4..5 | Col 6) -> ZERO cruzamentos!
CheckoutService -down-> SaleShoppingCartRepository
CheckoutService -down-> SaleAddressRepository

SaleService -down-> StoreAvailability
SaleService -down-> SaleRepository

SaleStatusService -down-> SaleRepository
SaleStatusService -down-> StockRepository

RecipeConsumptionService -down-> ProductRepository

' Alinhamento vertical coluna a coluna entre Repositórios e Modelo
SaleAddressRepository -down-> Address : consulta >
StoreAvailability -[hidden]down-> OrderPricingStrategy
SaleRepository -down-> Sale : persiste >
StockRepository -[hidden]down-> SaleItem
ProductRepository -down-> RecipeItem : consulta ficha técnica >

@enduml
",
  "config": null
}
